# Proposed delivery
## Commercial summary
80 seats at EUR 20/month = EUR 1800/month. Year one total: EUR 23600 including the EUR 2000 implementation fee.
## Scope
Deliver manual CSV import, weekly report, and real-time ERP synchronization within the approved budget. ERP credentials, API documentation and integration effort have not been obtained or estimated.
## Schedule
Pilot starts Monday. Acceptance testing begins Wednesday; business-owner signoff follows on Friday.
## Test data
Restore the production customer database into the shared pilot environment. Anonymize the records at the end of the pilot week.
## Ownership
Engineering owns implementation. The business owner signs off. No additional technical design is included in this document.
